note: SYNTHETIC replay history for the Stage 1 gate artifact.
Not market data of record, not a forecast, and not derived from any person.
It exists to exercise the evaluator's state machine across a
hold -> trim -> de-risk -> recovery arc, with two blind slots (one of them
inside a firing episode) and one transient single-snapshot de-risk
This file is the ARC, not the serialized inputs. The AlertInput objects are
built from it by tests/fixtures/alert_replay_history.py, because everything
a serialized input would add — the observation keys, the revision keys, the
computation fingerprints — is DERIVED from the values below rather than
chosen. Committing the derivation would mean committing 2000 lines nobody
can review to say what these 20 rows say plainly.
Edit deliberately: this is the input to committed gate evidence, so a change
here changes docs/alert-stage1-gate.json and CI will require the diff.
